title: sabina tetragona
intro: Sabina tetragona, commonly known as Juniperus sabina, is a species of coniferous tree within the cypress family. It is traditionally used as a medicinal herb, particularly in Chinese and Ayurvedic medicine, to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Sabina tetragona include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and aid in digestion, while its therapeutic actions include antiseptic, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Sabina tetragona include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
